raw.description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Location: Role is Hybrid and based in either Berlin or Darmstadt, Germany, with remote flexibility.

Your Role

We're hiring a Director of Talent Acquisition to own how this company hires. This isn't a caretaker role over a recruiting queue. You'll lead our Talent Acquisition and Employer Branding function — a team of five TA Partners and a TA Enablement & Analytics Partner — and build the operating model that makes hiring a genuine competitive advantage.

You're joining at a pivotal moment. The TA function is operational and delivering, but quality, consistency, and hiring manager capability haven't yet caught up with our ambitions. Our ability to scale from Series A through commercialization depends on hiring the right people, at the right pace, into the right roles — across fusion science, laser engineering, software, operations, and G&A. You won't inherit a finished machine. You'll build one.

What You'll Do

Team Leadership Lead and develop five TA Partners and the TA Enablement & Analytics Partner — setting clear expectations, building capability, and creating a high-performing team culture that delivers without you in every decision.

Hiring Standards and Rigour Build and maintain the TA operating standards: hiring processes, interview frameworks, scorecards, and decision criteria applied consistently across every function. Raise the bar on quality, not just throughput.

Capacity Planning Drive capacity planning in close partnership with Finance and department heads, ensuring TA is resourced and sequenced ahead of demand — never the bottleneck to a planned hire.

Hiring Manager Enablement Equip leaders to run structured, fair hiring processes through training, coaching, and tooling — reducing dependency on TA for process guidance and raising the quality of hiring decisions.

ATS and Data Own the ATS end to end: configuration, data integrity, adoption, and continuous improvement. Use pipeline data and KPIs to identify bottlenecks, drive process changes, and report progress that drives decisions rather than decorates them.

Employer Branding Build a consistent, differentiated presence in our target talent markets — LinkedIn, Glassdoor, job boards, events, and content — in partnership with Marketing, so inbound quality improves quarter on quarter.

Who You Are

• 10+ years of progressive talent acquisition experience, with meaningful time leading and developing recruiting teams

• Experience in a scaling tech, deep-tech, or engineering-heavy environment, hiring for specialised, hard-to-fill roles

• Fluent with AI in your daily recruiting work — sourcing, screening, content, analytics — and able to raise your team's bar on it

• A KPI-driven operator: structured interviewing, assessment design, capacity planning, and hiring manager enablement are core methods, not buzzwords

• Hands-on ATS ownership: configuration, vendor management, reporting, and driving adoption across recruiters and hiring managers

• Strong working knowledge of GDPR as it applies to candidate data, and of German employment law in hiring

• Fluent in English; German is a meaningful plus

What Sets You Apart

• You've built or significantly rebuilt a TA operating model — standards, processes, and team structure — in a company that doubled headcount

• You've made employer branding work in a competitive talent market, with results you can point to

• You have a point of view on what great talent acquisition looks like — and it's grounded in outcomes, not activity

• You're drawn to mission-driven companies and want your work to connect to something larger than the next quarter

Why This Role

• Own the function that most directly gates the growth of one of the most ambitious clean energy ventures in the world

• Build the hiring engine that carries a science-driven company from Series A through commercialization

• A leadership team that treats People as a strategic function, not a support desk

• Competitive compensation, equity participation, and benefits reflective of the talent bar we hold

What We Offer

• Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

• Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you'll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

• Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

• Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

• Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

• Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

• Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

• Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

• Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

• Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs — whether it's a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing, you choose what fits your lifestyle.

• Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

raw.description:

  • You’re a hunter – you’ll get a healthy supply of BDR leads and marketing opportunities, but you’ll prospect and tap into your network to knock down doors and blockers

  • You’re a product evangelist – you’ll solution Zip to meet the pain points today, but also with an eye toward our product of the future

  • You’re a builder – at a startup, you’re not just a team member, but you help build the team culture and bring your best practice to the org

You Will

  • Become a product expert – learning the Zip platform through and through, so that you’re demo ready

  • Become a procurement expert – learning the ins and outs of the procurement market, which is deeply ready for change and new solutions

  • Use cutting-edge sales intelligence and engagement solutions to prospect, manage deal cycles, and ultimately bring on new customers

Qualifications

  • 5+ year of closing experience in technology SaaS sales at enterprise level

title: Account Director Influencer Marketing & Social Media (m/w/d)
description: Das ist keine gewöhnliche Account-Rolle. Für einen unserer wichtigsten Kunden – eine der beliebtesten Social Brands der Welt – suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die einen großen internationalen Account strategisch führt, weiterentwickelt und auf das nächste Level bringt. Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für die Kundenbeziehung, führst das zuständige Team und steuerst anspruchsvolle Influencer- und Social-Media-Projekte. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit internationalen Stakeholdern zusammen und verbindest strategische Beratung mit exzellenter Umsetzung. Diese Position bietet dir die Chance, eine weltweit bekannte Marke aktiv mitzugestalten und Social- sowie Influencer Marketing in relevanter Größenordnung zu verantworten. Aufgaben Als Account Director Influencer Marketing & Social Media (m/w/d) übernimmst du die strategische und operative Führung eines unserer wichtigsten Kunden. Du verantwortest die gesamte Kundenbeziehung und bist zentrale Ansprechperson auf Entscheider:innenebene. Du entwickelst die Influencer- und Social-Media-Strategie gemeinsam mit dem Kunden kontinuierlich weiter. Du übersetzt internationale Marken- und Marketingziele in relevante, plattformgerechte Kampagnen und Always-on-Konzepte. Du führst strategische Präsentationen, Statusgespräche, Jahresplanungen und Performance-Reviews auf Deutsch und Englisch. Du verantwortest große Budgets, Timings, Ressourcen, Qualität und den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg des Accounts. Du steuerst ein interdisziplinäres Team aus Influencer Marketing, Creative, Production, Performance und Creator Relations. Du etablierst klare Prozesse und sorgst für eine verlässliche, effiziente und qualitativ hochwertige Umsetzung. Du erkennst strategische Wachstumschancen und entwickelst den Account proaktiv weiter. Du behältst Plattformtrends, kulturelle Entwicklungen und Veränderungen in der Creator Economy im Blick. Du analysierst Ergebnisse, leitest fundierte Empfehlungen ab und vertrittst diese überzeugend gegenüber dem Kunden. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu nationalen und internationalen Stakeholdern auf. Du setzt einen hohen Qualitätsstandard und bist Sparringspartner:in für den Kunden und dein Team. Qualifikation Mindestens sieben Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Influencer Marketing, Social Media Marketing, Account Management oder in der strategischen Markenberatung. Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Führung großer, anspruchsvoller oder internationaler Kunden. Nachweisbare Verantwortung für umfangreiche Kampagnen, Always-on-Etats und größere Budgets. Tiefes Verständnis der Creator Economy sowie der Plattformen TikTok, Instagram, YouTube und weiterer relevanter Social-Media-Kanäle. Erfahrung in der Entwicklung integrierter Influencer- und Social-Media-Strategien. Ausgeprägte Beratungsstärke und ein souveränes Auftreten gegenüber Senior Stakeholdern und Entscheider:innen. Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung interdisziplinärer Teams; disziplinarische Führungserfahrung ist ein Plus. Strategisches und unternehmerisches Denken, verbunden mit einer pragmatischen Hands-on-Mentalität. Sicherheit im Umgang mit KPIs, Reportings, Budgetsteuerung und datenbasierter Kampagnenoptimierung. Exzellente Präsentations-, Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und fließendes Englisch in Wort und Schrift – beides ist für diese Position zwingend erforderlich. Du bleibst auch bei hoher Dynamik, vielen Stakeholdern und anspruchsvollen Projekten strukturiert und souverän. Benefits Die außergewöhnliche Chance, eine der beliebtesten Social Brands der Welt zu betreuen und ihre Influencer- und Social-Media-Aktivitäten aktiv mitzugestalten. Gesamtverantwortung für einen unserer wichtigsten und größten Kunden. Große Kampagnen, relevante Budgets und internationale Sichtbarkeit. Enormer strategischer Gestaltungsspielraum und direkter Einfluss auf die Entwicklung des Accounts. Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Stakeholdern und führenden Creatorn. Ein interdisziplinäres Team aus Influencer Marketing, Creative, Production, Performance und Creator Relations. Ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direktem Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung. Unsere eigene Plattform LikeBase und ein Netzwerk aus über 12.000 Creatorn. Moderner Arbeitsplatz in Frankfurt am Main und hybrides Arbeiten. Eine Schlüsselposition mit langfristiger Entwicklungsperspektive. ACHTUNG: Kein Remote möglich - 3 Tage vor Ort in Frankfurt & bitte kein klassisches Anschreiben! Erzähl uns stattdessen von einer großen Influencer- oder Social-Media-Kampagne beziehungsweise einem Always-on-Ansatz, den du maßgeblich verantwortet hast: Was war die strategische und operative Herausforderung? Wie bist du vorgegangen und welche Verantwortung hattest du? Wie hast du den Kunden und das beteiligte Team geführt? Welche messbaren Ergebnisse konntest du erzielen? Was würdest du mit deinem heutigen Wissen anders machen? Bitte sende uns deine Antwort auf Englisch. Uns interessieren keine vertraulichen Kundendaten, sondern dein strategisches Denken, dein Führungsverständnis und dein konkreter Beitrag zum Erfolg. **Wenn du Lust auf einen Account mit echter Größe, internationaler Relevanz und enormem Potenzial hast, sollten wir uns kennenlernen. description: About lemon.markets 🍋 We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses, providing seamless access to capital markets. By empowering FinTechs, Banks and Wealth Managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers. lemon.markets provides a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform for simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure makes launching an investment product customer-centric and compliant. We abstract all complexity for our partners through a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal and operating in a clear regulatory framework. Enabling partners to launch in weeks, not months. We have experienced first-hand that brokerage infrastructure is broken. Building an investment product used to be highly expensive, challenging and cumbersome. We ease this pain by shielding our partners & their customers from the underlying complexity - and with that, we make investing seamlessly accessible to everyone. Because that’s exactly what we enjoy, going to places nobody else dares and solving hard problems. This not only creates tons of value when done right, but attracts the smartest minds - because outlier companies are built by exceptional people like you. Your mission: We are looking for a Working Student in Risk (f/m/x) to help us with our daily risk management tasks. This includes topics like operational and financial/ non‑financial risks, internal controls, and audit support. You will collect and organise information, analyse data, and support us in making our processes more automated and efficient. In this role, you get real hands‑on experience in how risk management works inside a regulated fintech. You’ll support both small projects and everyday tasks to help keep our risk management and audit processes running smoothly. You will work closely with the Risk team, and cross-functional with Tech, Product, Operations, Finance and Compliance. This gives you the chance to learn from experienced colleagues, take ownership of tasks, and make an impact from day one in a fast‑paced, modern work environment. In this role you will: You will not only support the Risk team on various day-to-day operational tasks & projects within Risk, Audit and associated teams, but also develop processes further within the various back office functions by questioning existing processes and not shying away from breaking new ground, advocating for digitalisation & efficiency where possible. Support general risk management activities across multiple risk categories (e.g. Credit, Market, Liquidity, Operational Risk) Assist in identifying, assessing, and documenting risk-related matters (among other counterparty, market risk, as well as IT and third-party assessments) Contribute to maintaining and improving risk registers, controls, and process documentation Support internal audit and follow‑up activities Perform quantitative and qualitative analysis to support risk assessments Gather risk‑related data and transform it into clear, structured insights Assist in incident reviews, root‑cause analysis, and remediation tracking Work cross‑functionally with engineering, product, and operations teams, as well as other back-office and control functions You will be successful in this role if: You are enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in economics, business administration or a quantitative or tech‑related field You enjoy working with data, numbers, structures, and analytical problems You are curious about risk management beyond a single domain You are eager to learn how risk processes work in modern fintech infrastructure You communicate clearly and document precisely You are proactive, reliable, and detail‑oriented You enjoy using or learning to work with tools like Atlassian and Google Suite, SQL, Python, and different AI LLMs (BI, SQL, Python or similar is a plus) You are fluent in written and spoken German and English You are based in Berlin How we take care of you: 🚀 Compensation package: Our working student positions are compensated at a fixed rate of €15-17 per hour. 💎 Make a real impact: Our start-up environment gives you the room to start your career, explore areas outside your role, and build expertise through ownership. As we mature and are backed by dwpbank, we’re adding a layer of resources and expertise you are benefiting from. 🕑 Flexible working hours: We know your studies come first. That’s why we offer flexible hours that adapt to your class schedule and exam periods, so you can plan your work time around your semester. 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from Berlin within a hybrid model. That being said, we encourage our working student lemoneers to come to the office regularly. Being on-site allows you to learn faster, provides a more immersive experience, helps you collaborate more effectively with the team, and ensures you fully benefit from hands-on support. 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, plus a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations so you always know where you stand, and what to do to level up. 🌱 People & culture : You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate. 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total. As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply. Dein Buddy: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einer ehemaligen BCG-Beraterin, die dich individuell begleitet und fordert. Deine Perspektive: Ein anschließender Einstieg als Trainee ist ausdrücklich möglich und in unserem Team bereits mehrfach Realität geworden. raw.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Strategy & AI Innovation
raw.description:
Deine Mission

Alle reden über AI. Bei uns baust du mit.

Ein 400-Milliarden-Dollar-Markt. Ein profitables Scale-up, das ihn mit AI und einem globalen Freelancer-Netzwerk neu denkt. Und mittendrin ein Team mit einer klaren Mission: die Qualität für mehr als 25.000 Talents in über 70 Ländern durch AI, Automatisierung und intelligente Prozesse kontinuierlich besser zu machen.

Wir suchen dich als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Strategy & AI Innovation in unserem Headquarter in München-Schwabing für unsere cross-funktionale strategische Taskforce. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Strategy, AI und Operations - gemeinsam mit AI Engineers, Product- und Operations-Expert:innen sowie einer ehemaligen BCG-Beraterin.
 
Das ist keine klassische Werkstudentenstelle. Du analysierst Probleme, entwickelst Lösungen, testest AI-Anwendungen und hilfst dabei, Ideen in echte Produkte zu verwandeln. Die Konzepte, an denen du arbeitest, landen nicht in einer Schublade - sie werden prototypisiert, diskutiert und fließen direkt in Entscheidungen unseres Leadership-Teams ein.
 
Was du wirklich machst

  • AI-Produkte mitentwickeln statt nur darüber sprechen: Du arbeitest an strategischen AI-Initiativen wie unserem Talent Assistant oder AutoQA 2.0 (KI-basierte Voice File Analyse) mit und hilfst, aus ersten Ideen konkrete Features und funktionierende Prototypen zu entwickeln - unter anderem mit Claude, ChatGPT oder Lovable.
  • Aus Ideen werden Entscheidungen: Du analysierst komplexe Fragestellungen, bereitest Business Cases auf und entwickelst Entscheidungsgrundlagen für unser Leadership-Team. Deine Analysen beeinflussen unmittelbar, welche AI-Initiativen umgesetzt werden.
  • AI braucht Struktur: Große Sprachmodelle sind nur so gut wie die Daten dahinter. Du unterstützt beim Aufbau von Kompetenzframeworks, Bewertungslogiken und Trainingsdaten, die unsere AI-Systeme intelligenter machen - nicht als Datentipper, sondern als jemand, der mitentscheidet, was überhaupt bewertet werden soll.
  • Eigene Projekte mit echtem Ownership: Du übernimmst eigenständig Themen von der ersten Analyse bis zum ersten Prototyp - ein neuer AI-Use-Case, ein Workflow, der heute noch manuell läuft, eine Automatisierung, ein neuer Lösungsansatz. Der Inhalt wechselt, der Anspruch nicht: Du bekommst Verantwortung, nicht nur Aufgaben.
  • Dort arbeiten, wo gerade der größte Hebel liegt: Du unterstützt unser Team dort, wo aktuell die spannendsten strategischen Fragestellungen entstehen. Das bedeutet Abwechslung, hohe Geschwindigkeit und sichtbaren Impact.
Warum diese Rolle dich außergewöhnlich schnell wachsen lässt
Wenn dich AI wirklich interessiert, lernst du hier nicht nur neue Tools kennen, sondern wie daraus Produkte entstehen: wie aus einer Idee ein funktionierender Prototyp wird, wie man AI sinnvoll in Geschäftsprozesse integriert, wie man eine Empfehlung entwickelt, die vor Geschäftsführung und Leadership Bestand hat - und wie man komplexe Probleme so strukturiert, dass daraus messbarer Business Impact entsteht.
Du arbeitest eng mit einer ehemaligen BCG-Beraterin sowie AI Engineers und Product-Expert:innen zusammen und bewegst dich täglich zwischen Strategie, Produktentwicklung und AI. 
Die letzte Werkstudentin ist anschließend als Trainee bei uns eingestiegen - nicht, weil wir es versprechen, sondern weil sie während ihrer Zeit bei uns bereits Verantwortung übernommen hat.


Dein Skillset

  • Akademischer Hintergrund: Du studierst aktuell im Master (BWL, VWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar) und bringst bereits erste praktische Erfahrung mit.
  • AI begeistert dich wirklich: Du musst keine Software entwickeln können - aber du beschäftigst dich freiwillig mit AI. Vielleicht nutzt du Claude oder ChatGPT täglich, hast schon mit Lovable oder Cursor experimentiert oder fragst dich regelmäßig: "Das müsste man doch automatisieren können." Genau diese Neugier suchen wir.
  • Fähigkeiten: Du strukturierst komplexe Sachverhalte sauber und nutzt PowerPoint und Excel sicher genug, um überzeugende Management-Präsentationen und Business Cases aufzubereiten.
  • Mindset: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand den nächsten Schritt erklärt. Du arbeitest dich gerne in neue Themen ein, denkst unternehmerisch und willst Lösungen entwickeln statt Aufgaben abzuarbeiten.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst und präsentierst in verhandlungssicherem Deutsch und Englisch und verfügst natürlich über eine gesunde Portion Humor. 
  • Rahmenbedingungen: Du hast 16 - 20 Stunden pro Woche während des Semesters Kapazität bei uns vor Ort im Münchner Headquarter tätig zu sein. In der vorlesungsfreien Zeit flexibel bis Vollzeit möglich.


Dein Winning Deal

  • Deine Chance: Vom ersten Tag an arbeitest du an einer der strategisch wichtigsten AI-Initiativen unseres Unternehmens mit und gestaltest Lösungen, die den Arbeitsalltag tausender Menschen verbessern können.
  • Dein Buddy: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einer ehemaligen BCG-Beraterin, die dich individuell begleitet und fordert.
  • Dein Netzwerk: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit AI Engineers, Product-, Strategy- und Operations-Expert:innen - Einblicke, die klassische Werkstudentenstellen selten bieten.
  • Deine Perspektive: Ein anschließender Einstieg als Trainee ist ausdrücklich möglich und in unserem Team bereits mehrfach Realität geworden. 
  • Deine Benefits:Neben weekly Pizza und Snacks vor Ort, bieten wir dir außerdem einen Joblunch-Zuschuss (4 x 6,90 € im Monat), eine bezuschusste Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft, Rabatte via "Corporate Benefits" sowie grandiose Team- und Companyevents.

  • 5+ years of experience in campaign management or integrated marketing, ideally in e-commerce or D2C

You excel at designing user flows and implementing them in React and TypeScript, while owning outcomes end-to-end across backend, data, AI-enabled workflows, and cloud deployment. If you are a passionate builder who thrives at the intersection of full-stack development and AI, this is your opportunity to work closely with the founders, shape the product, and help us scale toward €10M ARR in 2026.

Tasks

  • Owning end-to-end product workflows, from frontend UX to backend systems, data pipelines, and edge cases

  • Building world-class frontend experiences in React and TypeScript alongside scalable, reliable backend systems

  • Designing and owning AI-enabled systems, including embeddings, retrieval, and agents that create real operational leverage

  • Developing and operating data pipelines for large-scale unstructured data

  • Making pragmatic technical decisions on architecture, tools, and frameworks to balance speed and quality

  • Deploying, running, and maintaining software in cloud environments with a “you ship it, you run it” mindset

  • Writing clean, maintainable, and well-tested code with scalable, reusable components and APIs

  • Collaborating across the stack and raising the engineering bar through reviews, mentoring, and technical leadership

General Profile

We are looking for stellar engineers with a strong background in full-stack software engineering and AI, and the potential to grow and lead teams in the future. 3–5 years of experience is a plus, but we hire for skill, ownership, and output.

  • Generalist engineer with a frontend affinity, capable of building across backend, data, and AI

  • End-to-end product ownership, driving ideas from concept to customer-ready production

  • Proactive execution in ambiguous environments, turning unclear requirements into shipped software

  • High-speed delivery paired with a focus on clean code and scalable architecture

  • Close iteration with users and clients, including collaboration across different cultures

  • Strong problem-solving ability and fast adoption of new technologies

  • Motivation to build excellent software in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Willingness to work in-person in Munich with a higher intensity than a traditional 9–5 role

Technical skillset

  • Strong experience with full-stack software engineering, especially React and TypeScript, with excellent understanding of constructing user flows

  • Solid backend engineering skills, ideally with Node.js, and experience designing APIs and data model

  • Proven track record of architecting and building production-grade software systems

  • Cloud and DevOps experience with Docker

  • AI experience is a plus, especially embeddings and retrieval, structured outputs and tool calling, evals, and agentic workflows beyond prompt engineering

Leadership and communication

  • You naturally take responsibility and enjoy leading

  • You’re one of the strongest engineers in the team and make everyone else better

  • Everyone can come to you for advice on how to fix their hardest problems

  • You communicate clearly and are credible with technical stakeholders and clients

Bonus if you

  • Can share a portfolio of projects, shipped products, or a GitHub with meaningful work

  • Have experience scaling systems from early usage to larger production workloads

  • Have built workflow-heavy B2B products, internal tools, or operations software

  • Great central office in Munich with regular team events and dinners

  • Monthly Wellness budget

  • Access to any AI or productivity tools you need to do your best work

  • International scope & travel

  • Flexible work setup with time-zone responsibility

  • Meaningful compensation package including cash, performance bonus, and shares (Actual offers and compensation are based on specific job duties, experience, performance, total rewards structure, and other considerations).


About the interview process

Step 1: Intro call

Casual intro meeting with one of the founders to get to know each other and introduce SANOVIO.

Step 2: Technical interview

The technical interview consists of two parts:

  • A take-home exercise, including a short presentation

  • A system design interview

For the take-home exercise, we’d provide you with a task. Later, you’ll present your results to us.

Step 3: Personal Fit

Meet another co-founder to get a feel for our culture and working style.

Step 4: Offer & Reference Checks

If we see a great fit, you will get an offer, including a competitive compensation package. At the same time, we’ll ask you to provide 2–3 references so we can gather additional insights into your strengths and working style.

title: Senior/Principal Consultant SAP Security & Berechtigungen (m/w/d)
description: Deine Aufgaben Diese Aufgaben erwarten Dich: Du konzipierst, implementierst und optimierst SAP Berechtigungskonzepte – sowohl On-Premise als auch in Cloud-Umgebungen. Du berätst Kunden zu SAP Security- und Compliance-Themen, inklusive Governance, Risk & Compliance. Du führst Kundengespräche, Workshops und Presales-Termine eigenständig durch – von der Anforderungsaufnahme bis zur Lösungspräsentation. Du unterstützt bei Audits und analysierst sowie optimierst bestehende Berechtigungslandschaften. Du arbeitest an der Weiterentwicklung interner Best Practices und Security-Standards mit. Dein Profil Das bringst du mit: Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich SAP Berechtigungen bzw. SAP Authorization Management. Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in SAP Security, Identity & Access Management (IAM) und Segregation of Duties (SoD). Du bringst Erfahrung oder gute Kenntnisse in SAP GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) mit. Du kennst dich im Design und in der Implementierung von Berechtigungskonzepten sowie in der Rollen- und Benutzerverwaltung aus. Du hast Erfahrung mit Compliance-Anforderungen, Audit-Unterstützung und Risikobewertung. Du trittst beim Kunden sicher und professionell auf und kannst Kunden- und Presales-Gespräche eigenständig führen. Du kommunizierst klar, präsentierst überzeugend und arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und lösungsorientiert. Nice to have, wenn du außerdem Folgendes mitbringst: Erfahrung mit Xiting-Tools, insbesondere XAMS. Grundkenntnisse im Bereich SAP Basis. Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA-Transformationen. Zertifizierungen im Bereich SAP Security oder SAP GRC. Erfahrung in internationalen Projekten oder mit Cloud-Security, zum Beispiel SAP BTP. Warum wir? description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About us&nbsp;</strong>&nbsp;&nbsp;</h2> <p>Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology.&nbsp; Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.</p> <p>Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward.&nbsp; Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.&nbsp; <br><br>In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.</p> <p>At Wayve, your contributions matter.&nbsp; We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!&nbsp;&nbsp;</p></div><h2>About The Team</h2> <p>Wayve is building embodied AI that can drive any vehicle, anywhere. Our AI Driver runs on-vehicle in real time, and the <strong>Runtime Platform team</strong> owns the application frameworks, middleware (IPC / inter-process communication), monitoring, performance, and observability foundations that make that possible. This is a growing sub-team that we're breaking out into its own team, and you’ll be the Engineering Manager to lead it.</p> <h2>The role</h2> <p>As Engineering Manager for Runtime Platform, you'll lead a single team and be accountable for its delivery, engagement, resourcing, roadmap, and performance. People leadership is your first priority: you'll coach and grow the team, keep it engaged and high-performing, and own hiring as the team stands up. You'll pair that with strong technical judgment — setting clear technical direction on latency, profiling, real-time scheduling, and middleware, and owning the outcome of the team's technical decisions.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and grow the team (first priority):</strong> keep the team engaged, developing, and performing with good morale; run 1:1s, set clear expectations, give regular high-quality feedback, manage performance, and support career growth against our career framework.</li> <li><strong>Hire and build the team:</strong> own hiring and onboarding to get the right people in the right roles, and shape the team's culture and ways of working as it forms.</li> <li><strong>Drive execution:</strong> ensure the team's work advances company goals; staff committed programs, keep the roadmap aligned to available resources, prioritize, and hold the team accountable for delivery, quality, and operational reliability.</li> <li><strong>Set technical direction:</strong> ensure the team has a clear, holistic technical direction and clear ownership of its technology-roadmap milestones — working closely with the team's tech lead(s) and stakeholders; own the outcome of the team's technical decisions.</li> <li><strong>Own the runtime foundations:</strong> guide the team's work across system design, application frameworks, the middleware/IPC layer, performance &amp; optimization, and measurement &amp; observability. Enable new vehicle platform enablement with incremental work and minimal performance degradation. raw.description:
About the job

At Adclear, we're building the trust layer for how the world's most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review that slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We're turning the function that has always said 'no' into infrastructure that says 'yes, and here's how'.

 

This is a fundamental shift in how regulated industries and compliance teams operate, and we're only at the beginning. Your role here isn't just to hit a number, it's to help redefine how an entire market discovers what's possible, and to build the commercial engine that gets us there.

Founded in 2024, we've already gained the trust of leading innovators as well as established enterprises including Monzo, Lloyds, PensionBee, Kraken, Coinbase and many others.

Our early traction enabled us to raise £2.6m in funding and we're now looking to scale faster. We're moving from founder-led sales to a repeatable growth engine and we want someone who has built that engine before, not someone building it for the first time.

 

The Basics

📍 Location: London (4 days a week in our Farringdon office)

⏱️ Experience: 4+ years in outbound-heavy sales/GTM, including time spent building process, tooling, or a team from scratch

🧑‍💼 Reports to: Founders

💰 Pay: Competitive base with uncapped, meaningful upside plus equity

🥇 The role: Lead our commercial engine, own pipeline generation, close new business, and build the playbooks, tooling, and team structure that let us scale beyond founder-led sales

 

The Role

This is the role that builds and runs Adclear's UK commercial engine. We spent two years building a genuine community, a content engine, events and a strong network a lot of what you touch is already warm. But we need someone who's done more than work a warm desk: someone who has stood up a GTM motion before, knows what "repeatable" actually looks like, and can operate directly with founders without a playbook handed to them.

You'll close net-new business yourself, own the full cycle from outbound through to signed retainer, and build the systems - CRM, sequencing, reporting that let the function scale past you. As we grow, you'll be first in line to build and lead the team underneath this role.

You'll sell with the best growth tooling available. We invest in the stack so your time goes where it counts: in front of prospects and building the machine. We use Attio as our CRM, Clay for rev ops, Sales Nav for prospecting, Lemlist for outreach and we're building a fully AI-enabled stack that automates the busywork.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own the full GTM cycle end-to-end: ICP definition, outbound, discovery, pilot, close, and retainer conversion

  • Build and own the CRM, sequencing infrastructure, content-to-pipeline flow, and commercial playbook from the ground up

  • Run daily outbound across calls, email and LinkedIn, with phone/in-person meetings as your first move, not your last resort

  • Work our warm engine - content, events, podcast and community leads and convert events into pipeline yourself

  • Check inbound signals daily (website visits, demo sign-ups, content downloads) and act on what matters

  • Partner directly with the founders on pricing, positioning, and GTM strategy

  • Start building the hiring plan and playbook for the team you'll lead as the function scales

  • Report on pipeline health, conversion, and what's working well enough to double down on

 

What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)

  • You've closed net-new business personally and can point to a repeatable process behind it

  • You've built (or meaningfully upgraded) the CRM, sequencing, and reporting infrastructure the team runs on

  • You're operating with high autonomy and are trusted to make GTM strategy calls with the founders

  • You've made the case for, and started building, the team underneath you

 

Must-Haves

  • 4+ years in outbound-heavy sales or GTM, with a track record of building not just executing, process, tooling, or a team

  • Demonstrated ownership of a full commercial cycle: prospecting through close, ideally including team leadership or cross-functional GTM strategy work

  • Phone-first and comfortable in person you don't hide behind email and LinkedIn

  • Evidence of hitting or exceeding revenue targets in a scaling environment, with numbers to back it up

  • Genuine self-starter who's operated with minimal playbook before and built one from scratch

  • Sharp enough to hold a real conversation about a technical, regulated product without needing to be an expert on day one

  • Comfortable reporting directly to founders and operating with significant autonomy

 

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience selling into regulated industries: fintech, legaltech, or healthtech

  • Experience building or scaling an outbound or broker/referral channel from zero

  • Prior experience as a founding or early commercial hire at a startup

  • Direct experience owning or building CRM/rev-ops infrastructure

  • An established personal presence or content instinct on LinkedIn

 

How We Work

  • Founders are closely involved in the day-to-day

  • No rigid script: you test, learn and adapt on your own initiative

  • You own your pipeline end-to-end, including follow-through after a meeting is booked

  • The pace is fast and the approach is still being built you're one of the people building it

  • This isn't the right role if you want a fixed formula handed to you on day one

 

Benefits

  • Meaningful equity

  • Private healthcare and dental

  • Hardware budget

  • Monthly gym contribution

  • Direct path to building and leading the commercial team as we scale

raw.title: Senior Back-End Engineer - Ledger Platform
raw.description:
Senior Back-End Engineer - Ledger Platform

Hybrid in London (UK) or Remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Senior Back-End Engineer

This role is a chance to tackle complex, high-impact challenges at the heart of our fintech platform. You will join the team that owns iwoca's ledger — the system of record for the money we lend and collect — and you will be responsible for scaling it across the full lifecycle of our credit card and lending products, building the reconciliation and reporting that prove it correct, and laying the foundations for our next generation of products. This is a hands-on role: you'll design these systems, write the code, and own them in production.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Ledger Platform team owns the ledger across all of iwoca's products, from credit cards to our lending range, plus everything around it: reconciliation, financial reporting, and the data Finance, Accounting and Capital Markets run on. We work closely with a Product Manager, shipping frequently and owning our systems in production. Some of the team work fully remotely and others are hybrid, working 1-3 days per week in the London office.


The role

Responsibility and Autonomy:

  • Lead the delivery of projects involving many stakeholders and systems.

  • Go beyond the code to develop deep expertise in our domain — our core financial products and our stakeholders' needs — and become a trusted technical advisor to the business.

  • Perform detailed technical scoping and prototyping to support feasibility testing and decision making.

Delivery and Collaboration

  • Architect and implement scalable solutions for complex challenges: the lifecycle of an account, interest and repayment allocation, reconciliation, and how financial data reaches our reporting stack.

  • Use domain modelling to find the simple design behind a complicated problem, and structure software so that it is easy to understand, test and evolve.

  • Be pragmatic about which parts of a problem actually need solving now. The hardest work here is deciding what not to build.

  • Build solutions that avoid single points of failure, and make sure our releases happen with zero downtime.

  • Translate ambiguous product requirements into clear, actionable technical plans that guide the team's work.

  • Promptly investigate and fix live issues, and ensure they do not resurface. Own what you ship in production and keep it reliable and easy to operate.

  • Contribute high-quality, production-ready code and foster a collaborative environment by reviewing work and writing useful documentation.

Learning and Growth:

  • Work with the team to improve our development and agile practices and raise our engineering standards.

  • Share new approaches and tooling with the wider engineering group through our internal forums and company-wide talks.

AI:

  • We're pushing hard on AI-assisted development. Engineers here write clear technical specs, let skills and agents implement boiler-plate, and hold a high bar on code review — the person, not the model, is accountable for what merges. We expect AI output to be validated for correctness, performance and security like any other change.

  • We give the team unlimited tokens across all models and expect people to experiment.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Extensive back-end engineering experience.

  • Experience building and running microservices and distributed systems in production. Comfortable reasoning about durable cross-service communication, transactional correctness, and failure modes at scale.

  • Extensive experience with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, but open to MySQL or similar (e.g., MS SQL, Oracle); emphasis is on data integrity.

  • Experience with systems where correctness is a hard requirement — ledgers, accounting, billing or payments, ideally in a regulated setting — including the invariants, immutable audit trails and reconciliation controls that enforce it.

  • Experience leading a feature or project end to end — scoping, design, delivery, and running it in production.

  • You use AI (like Cursor, Claude Code or similar) in your daily flow - whether for work or for fun. You use it to blast through boilerplate and research, so you can focus on the hard parts: complex architecture, rigour, and high-stakes decision-making.

  • A strong technical or mathematical foundation, evidenced by a degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Maths or similar) or equivalent professional experience.

  • You work well as a peer: pairing on hard problems, giving useful code review, and unblocking teammates day-to-day.

  • Clear written and verbal communication — you can explain a technical trade-off to Finance, and a business constraint back to engineers.

Bonus:

  • A background in high-logic or high-scale fields like Fintech, Gaming, Healthcare Tech, Logistics, Security/Cryptography or similar.

  • Working knowledge of modern data tooling - ideally Snowflake and dbt - used to build analytical or reporting pipelines.

  • Knowledge of messaging frameworks and event-driven patterns (e.g. Kafka).

The salary

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £110,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We’re looking for a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Experience team at Pleo. In this role, you’ll own a portfolio of large, complex, and strategically important enterprise customers, helping them achieve measurable business outcomes, expand adoption, manage change, and build long-term value with Pleo. You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders while coordinating the broader Pleo relationship across Customer Success, Product, Support, Sales, Finance, and other internal teams. This is not a reactive account-management role. You’ll be expected to understand each customer’s business priorities, operating model, success criteria, and risk profile. You’ll turn that understanding into clear success plans, executive engagement strategies, adoption programs, renewal plans, and growth opportunities. The right candidate will bring at least three years of direct experience managing enterprise customers , along with the communication skills, commercial judgment, and operational discipline required to manage high-value relationships in a fast-paced technology environment. Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to our Manager of Customer Success, Large & High-Growth Customers and work closely with teams across: Customer Support Customer Onboarding Sales and Account Management Product and Product Operations Revenue Operations Finance Data and Analytics Program Management and Operations You’ll work with customer stakeholders across finance, procurement, operations, technology, transformation, and executive leadership. You’ll be responsible for creating alignment across these stakeholders, establishing clear governance, and ensuring Pleo remains connected to the customer’s evolving strategic and operational priorities. What you’ll be doing As a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager , you will: Own a portfolio of enterprise customers with accountability for customer health, value realisation, adoption, retention, renewal readiness, advocacy, and growth. Build trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders , positioning yourself as a credible advisor who understands their business priorities and operating environment. Develop detailed customer success plans that connect the customer’s strategic goals to measurable outcomes, adoption milestones, responsibilities, and timelines. Lead executive business reviews and strategic customer meetings that demonstrate value, address risks, align stakeholders, and create clear next steps. Drive product adoption across complex customer organisations , helping customers expand usage across teams, entities, locations, use cases, and workflows. Create and maintain detailed stakeholder maps , identifying decision-makers, champions, influencers, operational contacts, blockers, and executive sponsors. Identify churn risk early using product usage, engagement, stakeholder, support, financial, organisational, and external business signals. Build and execute churn-prevention plans with clear actions, owners, timelines, customer commitments, and executive escalation paths. Maintain detailed and accurate forecasts across renewals, risk, customer health, expected outcomes, growth opportunities, and major account milestones. Lead renewal-readiness activities by ensuring customer value is documented, risks are addressed, stakeholders are aligned, and commercial partners have accurate account intelligence. Identify and support expansion opportunities by connecting additional Pleo capabilities, products, or use cases to the customer’s evolving business needs. Coordinate complex customer escalations across Support, Product, Engineering, Finance, and other teams while maintaining clear and confident customer communication. Act as the customer’s internal advocate , ensuring customer needs, feedback, risks, and opportunities are visible to the right stakeholders at Pleo. Navigate customer change effectively , including leadership transitions, reorganisations, acquisitions, market expansion, platform changes, and evolving business priorities. Track customer commitments and outcomes with strong operational discipline, ensuring actions are documented, owned, and completed. Contribute to the evolution of Pleo’s enterprise Customer Success model by sharing best practices, customer insights, playbooks, and recommendations. Support peer development and knowledge sharing across the Customer Success team without holding direct people-management responsibility. To put things into context In this role, you can expect to work on priorities such as: strengthening relationships with Pleo’s largest and most strategic customers improving enterprise customer retention and renewal predictability increasing adoption across complex customer organisations creating stronger executive engagement and governance identifying churn risk before it becomes a renewal issue improving forecast accuracy and account visibility coordinating complex customer needs across multiple internal teams helping customers quantify and communicate the value they receive from Pleo identifying opportunities for expansion and deeper product adoption improving the consistency and quality of enterprise success planning helping customers navigate operational and organisational change turning customer feedback into actionable Product and CX insight You can expect to work across a technology environment that includes CRM, Customer Success platforms, support systems, product analytics, business intelligence tools, workflow tools, and collaboration platforms . Examples may include Vitally, Gainsight or similar, Zendesk, Looker, Tableau or Power BI, Jira, Asana, and Slack. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: At least three years of direct enterprise Customer Success or strategic account-management experience , managing large, complex, and high-value B2B customers. Five or more years of overall experience in Customer Success, account management, consulting, implementation, or a related customer-facing role. Experience working in SaaS, fintech, enterprise technology, or another complex B2B technology environment . A proven record of retaining and growing enterprise customers , including managing renewals, adoption, risk, and value realisation. Strong executive relationship-management skills , with the confidence and credibility to engage senior decision-makers and business leaders. Experience managing complex stakeholder environments involving multiple teams, business units, regions, entities, or decision-makers. Strong churn-prediction and prevention skills , including the ability to interpret customer signals, identify root causes, and build effective recovery plans. Detailed forecasting experience across renewals, customer risk, account health, adoption, and expansion opportunities. Strong commercial judgment , with an understanding of how customer outcomes connect to retention, revenue, expansion, and long-term account value. Excellent verbal and written communication skills , including the ability to lead difficult conversations, present to executives, and simplify complex issues. Experience building strategic success plans, account plans, stakeholder maps, and executive business reviews . Strong analytical skills , with the ability to interpret customer data, product usage, service trends, and business information. Strong cross-functional leadership skills , with the ability to align internal stakeholders without relying on direct authority. A structured and proactive approach to account management , with excellent follow-through and attention to detail. Comfort working in a fast-paced growth environment where customer expectations, internal priorities, and business needs can evolve quickly. The ability to balance strategic relationship management with detailed operational execution . Nice to have Experience in fintech, payments, spend management, financial operations, or expense-management technology Experience working with finance leaders, procurement teams, controllers, CFO organisations, or transformation leaders Experience managing multi-country or multinational enterprise customers Familiarity with ERP, accounting, procurement, or financial-system integrations Experience supporting customers through significant organisational or technology transformation Exposure to AI-enabled Customer Success, predictive health models, automated risk detection, or digital engagement Experience partnering with Product teams on strategic customer feedback and roadmap discussions Experience managing accounts with complex security, compliance, governance, or implementation requirements Why is this role a good fit for you? This role is a good fit for you if: You enjoy building strategic relationships with complex enterprise customers. You are comfortable engaging senior leaders and navigating high-stakes customer situations. You know how to connect product adoption to measurable customer outcomes. You are proactive about identifying and addressing churn risk. You combine strong relationship skills with rigorous account-management discipline. You are confident leading executive reviews, renewal discussions, and difficult customer conversations. You enjoy coordinating internal teams around complex customer needs. You want direct responsibility for protecting and growing some of Pleo’s most important customer relationships. This role is not a good fit for you if: You have not directly managed enterprise or strategic customer relationships. You prefer transactional or high-volume customer portfolios. You are uncomfortable owning customer risk, retention, and renewal readiness. You prefer reacting to customer requests rather than building proactive engagement strategies. You are uncomfortable engaging executive stakeholders or leading difficult conversations. You do not enjoy detailed forecasting, CRM management, and account planning. You prefer working independently without significant cross-functional coordination. You are looking for a people-management role rather than a senior individual-contributor position. How you’ll develop in this role In your first 1 month at Pleo, you’ll: Learn Pleo’s product, enterprise customer journey, value proposition, and Customer Success operating model. Build a detailed understanding of your customer portfolio, including revenue, renewal dates, usage, stakeholders, open issues, risks, and growth potential. Establish relationships with key customer stakeholders and internal account partners. Review and improve success plans, stakeholder maps, account plans, and risk assessments. Establish clear operating rhythms for customer engagement, internal coordination, and forecasting. Identify immediate risks, adoption gaps, and opportunities across your portfolio. In your first 3 months, you’ll: Lead consistent executive and operational engagement across your customer portfolio. Improve customer success planning, value documentation, and renewal readiness. Strengthen the accuracy and detail of customer health and renewal forecasts. Deliver measurable progress against adoption, engagement, and customer outcome goals. Build and execute mitigation plans for at-risk customers. Identify and support qualified expansion opportunities. Become a trusted advisor to customer stakeholders and a reliable source of account intelligence internally. In your first 5 months, you’ll: Build a healthy and well-managed portfolio of enterprise customers. Deliver strong retention and renewal performance. Improve adoption and value realisation across complex customer organisations. Develop trusted relationships with senior and executive customer stakeholders. Demonstrate strong forecast accuracy and proactive risk management. Contribute repeatable best practices and insight to Pleo’s broader enterprise Customer Success model. Be recognised as a senior individual contributor capable of managing Pleo’s most important and complex customer relationships. Success in this role looks like Enterprise customers have clear success plans connected to measurable business outcomes. Executive and operational customer relationships are strong and multi-threaded. Customer risks are identified early and addressed through structured mitigation plans. raw.title: Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager
raw.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Experience team at Pleo. In this role, you’ll own a portfolio of large, complex, and strategically important enterprise customers, helping them achieve measurable business outcomes, expand adoption, manage change, and build long-term value with Pleo.

You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders while coordinating the broader Pleo relationship across Customer Success, Product, Support, Sales, Finance, and other internal teams.

This is not a reactive account-management role. You’ll be expected to understand each customer’s business priorities, operating model, success criteria, and risk profile. You’ll turn that understanding into clear success plans, executive engagement strategies, adoption programs, renewal plans, and growth opportunities.

The right candidate will bring at least three years of direct experience managing enterprise customers, along with the communication skills, commercial judgment, and operational discipline required to manage high-value relationships in a fast-paced technology environment.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Manager of Customer Success, Large & High-Growth Customers and work closely with teams across:

  • Customer Support

  • Customer Onboarding

  • Sales and Account Management

  • Product and Product Operations

  • Revenue Operations

  • Finance

  • Data and Analytics

  • Program Management and Operations

You’ll work with customer stakeholders across finance, procurement, operations, technology, transformation, and executive leadership.

You’ll be responsible for creating alignment across these stakeholders, establishing clear governance, and ensuring Pleo remains connected to the customer’s evolving strategic and operational priorities.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will:

  • Own a portfolio of enterprise customers with accountability for customer health, value realisation, adoption, retention, renewal readiness, advocacy, and growth.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders, positioning yourself as a credible advisor who understands their business priorities and operating environment.

  • Develop detailed customer success plans that connect the customer’s strategic goals to measurable outcomes, adoption milestones, responsibilities, and timelines.

  • Lead executive business reviews and strategic customer meetings that demonstrate value, address risks, align stakeholders, and create clear next steps.

  • Drive product adoption across complex customer organisations, helping customers expand usage across teams, entities, locations, use cases, and workflows.

  • Create and maintain detailed stakeholder maps, identifying decision-makers, champions, influencers, operational contacts, blockers, and executive sponsors.

  • Identify churn risk early using product usage, engagement, stakeholder, support, financial, organisational, and external business signals.

  • Build and execute churn-prevention plans with clear actions, owners, timelines, customer commitments, and executive escalation paths.

  • Maintain detailed and accurate forecasts across renewals, risk, customer health, expected outcomes, growth opportunities, and major account milestones.

  • Lead renewal-readiness activities by ensuring customer value is documented, risks are addressed, stakeholders are aligned, and commercial partners have accurate account intelligence.

  • Identify and support expansion opportunities by connecting additional Pleo capabilities, products, or use cases to the customer’s evolving business needs.

  • Coordinate complex customer escalations across Support, Product, Engineering, Finance, and other teams while maintaining clear and confident customer communication.

  • Act as the customer’s internal advocate, ensuring customer needs, feedback, risks, and opportunities are visible to the right stakeholders at Pleo.

  • Navigate customer change effectively, including leadership transitions, reorganisations, acquisitions, market expansion, platform changes, and evolving business priorities.

  • Track customer commitments and outcomes with strong operational discipline, ensuring actions are documented, owned, and completed.

  • Contribute to the evolution of Pleo’s enterprise Customer Success model by sharing best practices, customer insights, playbooks, and recommendations.

  • Support peer development and knowledge sharing across the Customer Success team without holding direct people-management responsibility.

To put things into context

In this role, you can expect to work on priorities such as:

  • strengthening relationships with Pleo’s largest and most strategic customers

  • improving enterprise customer retention and renewal predictability

  • increasing adoption across complex customer organisations

  • creating stronger executive engagement and governance

  • identifying churn risk before it becomes a renewal issue

  • improving forecast accuracy and account visibility

  • coordinating complex customer needs across multiple internal teams

  • helping customers quantify and communicate the value they receive from Pleo

  • identifying opportunities for expansion and deeper product adoption

  • improving the consistency and quality of enterprise success planning

  • helping customers navigate operational and organisational change

  • turning customer feedback into actionable Product and CX insight

You can expect to work across a technology environment that includes CRM, Customer Success platforms, support systems, product analytics, business intelligence tools, workflow tools, and collaboration platforms.

Examples may include Vitally, Gainsight or similar, Zendesk, Looker, Tableau or Power BI, Jira, Asana, and Slack.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • At least three years of direct enterprise Customer Success or strategic account-management experience, managing large, complex, and high-value B2B customers.

  • Five or more years of overall experience in Customer Success, account management, consulting, implementation, or a related customer-facing role.

  • Experience working in SaaS, fintech, enterprise technology, or another complex B2B technology environment.

  • A proven record of retaining and growing enterprise customers, including managing renewals, adoption, risk, and value realisation.

  • Strong executive relationship-management skills, with the confidence and credibility to engage senior decision-makers and business leaders.

  • Experience managing complex stakeholder environments involving multiple teams, business units, regions, entities, or decision-makers.

  • Strong churn-prediction and prevention skills, including the ability to interpret customer signals, identify root causes, and build effective recovery plans.

  • Detailed forecasting experience across renewals, customer risk, account health, adoption, and expansion opportunities.

  • Strong commercial judgment, with an understanding of how customer outcomes connect to retention, revenue, expansion, and long-term account value.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to lead difficult conversations, present to executives, and simplify complex issues.

  • Experience building strategic success plans, account plans, stakeholder maps, and executive business reviews.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret customer data, product usage, service trends, and business information.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to align internal stakeholders without relying on direct authority.

  • A structured and proactive approach to account management, with excellent follow-through and attention to detail.

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced growth environment where customer expectations, internal priorities, and business needs can evolve quickly.

  • The ability to balance strategic relationship management with detailed operational execution.

Nice to have

  • Experience in fintech, payments, spend management, financial operations, or expense-management technology

  • Experience working with finance leaders, procurement teams, controllers, CFO organisations, or transformation leaders

  • Experience managing multi-country or multinational enterprise customers

  • Familiarity with ERP, accounting, procurement, or financial-system integrations

  • Experience supporting customers through significant organisational or technology transformation

  • Exposure to AI-enabled Customer Success, predictive health models, automated risk detection, or digital engagement

  • Experience partnering with Product teams on strategic customer feedback and roadmap discussions

  • Experience managing accounts with complex security, compliance, governance, or implementation requirements

Why is this role a good fit for you?

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You enjoy building strategic relationships with complex enterprise customers.

  • You are comfortable engaging senior leaders and navigating high-stakes customer situations.

  • You know how to connect product adoption to measurable customer outcomes.

  • You are proactive about identifying and addressing churn risk.

  • You combine strong relationship skills with rigorous account-management discipline.

  • You are confident leading executive reviews, renewal discussions, and difficult customer conversations.

  • You enjoy coordinating internal teams around complex customer needs.

  • You want direct responsibility for protecting and growing some of Pleo’s most important customer relationships.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You have not directly managed enterprise or strategic customer relationships.

  • You prefer transactional or high-volume customer portfolios.

  • You are uncomfortable owning customer risk, retention, and renewal readiness.

  • You prefer reacting to customer requests rather than building proactive engagement strategies.

  • You are uncomfortable engaging executive stakeholders or leading difficult conversations.

  • You do not enjoy detailed forecasting, CRM management, and account planning.

  • You prefer working independently without significant cross-functional coordination.

  • You are looking for a people-management role rather than a senior individual-contributor position.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 1 month at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Learn Pleo’s product, enterprise customer journey, value proposition, and Customer Success operating model.

  • Build a detailed understanding of your customer portfolio, including revenue, renewal dates, usage, stakeholders, open issues, risks, and growth potential.

  • Establish relationships with key customer stakeholders and internal account partners.

  • Review and improve success plans, stakeholder maps, account plans, and risk assessments.

  • Establish clear operating rhythms for customer engagement, internal coordination, and forecasting.

  • Identify immediate risks, adoption gaps, and opportunities across your portfolio.

In your first 3 months, you’ll:

  • Lead consistent executive and operational engagement across your customer portfolio.

  • Improve customer success planning, value documentation, and renewal readiness.

  • Strengthen the accuracy and detail of customer health and renewal forecasts.

  • Deliver measurable progress against adoption, engagement, and customer outcome goals.

  • Build and execute mitigation plans for at-risk customers.

  • Identify and support qualified expansion opportunities.

  • Become a trusted advisor to customer stakeholders and a reliable source of account intelligence internally.

In your first 5 months, you’ll:

  • Build a healthy and well-managed portfolio of enterprise customers.

  • Deliver strong retention and renewal performance.

  • Improve adoption and value realisation across complex customer organisations.

  • Develop trusted relationships with senior and executive customer stakeholders.

  • Demonstrate strong forecast accuracy and proactive risk management.

  • Contribute repeatable best practices and insight to Pleo’s broader enterprise Customer Success model.

  • Be recognised as a senior individual contributor capable of managing Pleo’s most important and complex customer relationships.

Success in this role looks like

  • Enterprise customers have clear success plans connected to measurable business outcomes.

  • Executive and operational customer relationships are strong and multi-threaded.

  • Customer risks are identified early and addressed through structured mitigation plans.

  • Renewal forecasts are detailed, accurate, and supported by clear account evidence.

  • Customers demonstrate stronger product adoption and value realisation.

  • Escalations are managed with urgency, clarity, and strong customer communication.

  • Internal teams are aligned around customer priorities, responsibilities, and next steps.

  • Renewal and retention performance is strong across the assigned portfolio.

  • Expansion opportunities are identified through customer value and business need rather than transactional selling.

  • Pleo is viewed as a strategic partner rather than simply a product provider.

Candidate profile summary

The strongest candidate for this role is an experienced enterprise Customer Success professional who combines senior-level relationship skills with commercial awareness, analytical thinking, and disciplined account execution.

They have at least three years of direct enterprise experience and are comfortable managing complex customers with multiple stakeholders, high expectations, and significant revenue impact.

They know how to earn executive trust, demonstrate value, predict and prevent churn, maintain accurate forecasts, and mobilise cross-functional teams around customer outcomes. They are proactive, credible, highly organised, and capable of protecting and growing Pleo’s most strategic customer relationships.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.
